name: Pinkybites
source:
Mercy, an Arch-Duchess that has been sleeping for four centuries, did not ask to be resurrected by three broke musicians in a suburban basement. And yet, here we are. 

Follow her as she navigates the absolute horror of the 21st century alongside her accidental new band.

[Edited from [url=https://balzackgames.itch.io/pinkybites]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅西是一位已经沉睡了四个世纪的大公爵夫人，她并没有要求在郊区地下室里被三位破产的音乐家复活。然而，我们到了。

跟随她，与她意外的新乐队一起穿越21世纪的绝对恐怖。

[编辑自[url=https://balzackgames.itch.io/pinkybites]itch.io[/url]]
